text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing that Kitasan Black was looking 
rather fatigued, I brought her to the 
infirmary to rest.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry! Since I've made you worry so 
much, I'll recover in no time at all!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Mmm...? Huh, where am I...?

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
And here it is! The Universal Karaoke 
Showdown! Representing Earth, we have 
Kitasan Black!

text_block_list.name: Earth Fans
text_block_list.text:
"Do your best, Kitasan~! Your singing can 
work miracles!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Wah, thank you so much for the support! 
Hehe, calling my singing a miracle is 
just...

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Now, if you successfully ring the bell, 
the crisis of Earth's total destruction 
will be averted!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Eeeeehhk!?

text_block_list.name: Earth Fans
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan... Save us! Please, your singing 
is our only hope...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
......! I'm the only one they can rely 
on...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"...Understood. Even if the Earth is in 
crisis, I will save it."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Because that Helper Kitasan is who I truly 
am! Reach them—!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ding-dong-dang-dong, 
ding-dong-dang-dooon... Ehehe, ehehehe... 
I passed...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
F-Fufufu~. I went and saved the Earth 
too~. Ehehehehe...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black seems to have gotten plenty 
of rest, greeting me with a face full of 
energy.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Because that Helper Kitasan is who I truly 
am! Reach them—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ding)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeehhhk!? I haven't even started singing 
yet!?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
O-One more time! Please give me one more 
review~~!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
“......*Gasp*. Is this—the infirmary? So 
what just happened was a dream......?”

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Uuuugh... I wish they'd at least listened 
to my song before judging it...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Due to having bad dreams, Kitasan Black 
was unable to get enough rest...
